died.name: Anthony of Padua
died.desc: Portuguese Catholic priest and Franciscan friar
died.last_words: I see my God. He calls me to Him.

died.name: William Battie
died.last_words: Young man, you have heard, no doubt, how great are the terrors of death. This night will probably afford you some experience; but you may learn, and may you profit by the example, that a conscientious endeavor to perform his duty through life will ever close a Christian's eyes with comfort and tranquility!

died.name: Henry Segrave
died.desc: British land speed and water speed record pioneer
died.cause: mortally injured in crash of Miss England II. He was asking his wife about the fates of his chief engineer (who was killed) and his mechanic (who survived), and whether they had broken the water speed record (they had)
died.last_words: How are the lads? Did we do it?
